title: Ay Shaame Gharibaan
body:
Ay Shaame Gharibaan
Ay Shaame Gharibaan
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x9
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashon se bhara dasht hai jhalte huwe khaimen.
Hai Jhalti huwi rait pe sehme huwe bache (Ay Shame ghariban) x3
Bar Raige tapa girya-e-atfaale pareshaan.
<<MINI>>
Ay shame gharibaan
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Who dekh mere sher ka laasha hai labe juu.
Haan dhundh ke laade mujhe Abbas ke baazu (Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x3
Haan laasha-e-Abbas sare saahil-e-viraan Ay shame gharibaan
<<MINI>>
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Naazon se pale ghunja dahen gesuon waale, Lowta de mere ghar ko mere ghar ke ujaale (Ay shame gharibaan) x3
Sab gaif ke shud khana-e-man teera-o-viraan.
<<MINI>>
Ay shame gharibaan
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Pohncha de lab-e-nehr Sakeena ki sada ko Baba ko bulaati hai kabhi apne chacha ko (Ay Shame Ghariban) x3
Aawaze Sakeena berasan barsare maidaan Ay Shame Ghariban
<<MINI>>
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaa dhundhe agar dhundh sake teri nagaahain Do chaand meri doob gaye dasht-e-balaa mein (Ay Shame Gharibaan) x3
As Aun-o-Mohammed shuda khaali chamanistaan Ay shame ghariban
<<MINI>>
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Aik teer ne cheda hai zara dekh yahan par Asgher ka ghala bhaai ka bazu dil-e-maadar (Ay shame gharibaan) x3
Amaaz shuda teer-e sitam Asgher-e-nadaan Ay shame Ghariban
<<MINI>>
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Maktool-e-jafaa teen shab-o-rowz ka pyaasa Mehroom kafan se hai Muhammad ka nawasa (Ay shame Ghariban) x3
Be ghoro kafan sibt-e-nabi barsare maidaan Ay shame Ghariban
<<MINI>>
(Ay Shaame Gharibaan) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ba aseeri passe aashoor raseeda, wawayla wawayla
